scope: Shared-host strict TCP component transfer; no opt-in recovery CPU, native MVM, WAN, energy or causal/statistical acceptance claim

source_pins.note: Later fixture-only source is not the executed binary commit; broker_objects engine unchanged

verification.publication_identity_normalization: Published byte-array IDs/namespaces converted to lowercase hex and matched against offline hex IDs/namespaces; all12 cells verified

statistic: Median of three paired 100*(after/before-1), all preregistered trials retained; distinct from ratio of column medians

domains.cpu: Aggregate ProcessTime counted once; sender/receiver ThreadTime independent; operation/setup ProcessTime intervals overlap
domains.time: Verified wall includes durable publication and receiver readback; offline reverify, cleanup, lifecycle separately measured
domains.wire: Both canonical directions including framing/status/setup; excludes TCP/IP headers and TCP retransmission
domains.crypto: Identity/ciphertext numeric JSON lengths vary; semantic target IDs/lengths/application sizes matched, wire bytes retained unnormalized
